strategy: Navigate toward the goal by checking available directions and moving only when safe.
decisions: if the goal is ahead and the front path is clear, move FORWARD
if the goal is to the left and the left path is clear, turn LEFT and move FORWARD
if the goal is to the right and the right path is clear, turn RIGHT and move FORWARD
if no safe direction is available, STOP
stop_condition: when no safe direction is available for movement
